backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profile management, shop openings, products, testimonials, and baking tips with role-based access control using MixinAuthorization and AccessControl modules.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the completion of multi-page restructuring from single-page layout, including routing updates, header navigation, and internal link modifications across 4 main requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files for the multi-page React application with routing and authentication.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color variable definitions for light and dark themes, including custom luxury bakery color palette (cream, blush, chocolate, gold).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and root div mounting point for Crème Patisserie.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with 6 routes (home, about, menu, celebrations, contact, admin) wrapped in QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers with shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationSecti: Celebration occasions section displaying four occasion types (birthdays, anniversaries, gifts, corporate) with emoji icons over a dimmed background image.
frontend/src/components/CustomerQuerySec: Empty placeholder component file with no content.
Final call-to-action section with background image, headline, and Order Now button that navigates to /contact using React Router Link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright, attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters, and heart icon in gold theme color.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation menu for 5 pages, active page highlighting, mobile hamburger menu, conditional admin button for authenticated admins, and Order Now CTA button.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component displaying a full-screen banner with cafe background image, headline "Where Aesthetics Meet Indulgence", tagline about handcrafted bakes, and two CTA buttons linking to the contact page.
Location section component displaying business information (address in Civil Lines Jhansi, hours, phone, Instagram) in a grid layout with icons, plus buttons for directions and calling.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/MenuHighlightsSe: Menu highlights section displaying a grid of 5 signature items (cupcakes, brownies, Korean bun, custom cakes, celebration cakes) with images, plus buttons to view full menu in a dialog or download menu as webp.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Testimonials section showing a 4.9-star rating with two customer reviews from Sanskriti Mishra and Ajit Singh, displayed in styled cards with star ratings.
frontend/src/components/WhySection.tsx: "Why choose us" section with headline "More Than A Bakery. An Experience." and a 2x2 grid of four features (premium ingredients, beautiful presentation, perfect for gifting, loved by Jhansi) with checkmark icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor instance, handling both authenticated (with Internet Identity) and anonymous modes, with admin token initialization support.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Authentication hooks providing `useIsAdmin` and `useGetCallerUserRole` queries to check admin status and user role from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file noting that customer query functionality has been removed; kept to avoid breaking imports but contains no active queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display and Inter), configures Tailwind, and defines a custom OKLCH color palette with cream, blush, chocolate, and gold colors for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page component that renders WhySection and TestimonialsSection components with top padding.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with authentication checks using useIsAdmin hook, showing access denied for non-admins and a placeholder admin panel for authorized users.
frontend/src/pages/CelebrationsPage.tsx: Celebrations page component that renders the CelebrationSection component with top padding.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page component that renders LocationSection and FinalCTASection components with top padding.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page component that renders only the HeroSection component without additional padding.
frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx: Menu page component that renders the MenuHighlightsSection component with top padding.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that extends the default theme with custom OKLCH color palette (cream, blush, chocolate, gold), custom fonts (Playfair Display and Inter), container settings, border radius variables, and custom box shadows.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting a Crème Patisserie website on Internet Computer with existing features for multi-page restructuring (3-5 pages) and a pending request to modify Version 10 for customer sales.
